name: Basic Trains
description: Basic Trains is a domino game in the train family played with a double-nine or double-twelve set. There is no boneyard: players receive their tiles, each starts a personal train with a double if possible, and then extends trains by matching open ends.

content.text: Basic Trains is a domino game in the train family played with a double-nine or double-twelve set. There is no boneyard: players receive their tiles, each starts a personal train with a double if possible, and then extends trains by matching open ends.

Basic Trains belongs to the disconnected-layout train family of domino games. It uses the personal-train idea without the shared public train and without a boneyard, making it a simpler relative of later train games.
Four to ten players. The rules table gives hand sizes for double-nine and double-twelve sets according to player count.
A double-nine or double-twelve domino set. Leftover tiles are set aside face down and are not used as a boneyard.
Domino set and enough table space for each player to maintain a personal train.
Deal all playable hands according to player count; any leftover tiles are put aside face down and are not drawn during play.

items.text: Double-nine set: Hand sizes are smaller with the double-nine set and support four to ten players.
Double-twelve set: The larger double-twelve set supports larger hand sizes under the same train rules.
